captions.detailed: This is a simple, uniform cylindrical ring with a flat top and bottom edge. It has a relatively thin wall thickness and a wide, smooth outer band. The inner surface is completely hollowed out to form a clean circular opening.
captions.instruction: Design a customizable ring with a circular cross-section. The design must include parameters for the inner ring size (diameter), ring thickness, ring width, and an option to engrave a custom text message along the outer cylindrical surface using the write/Write.scad library.
captions.factory: The design is constructed using a nested difference() operation. An outer cylinder is created with a radius equal to the inner radius plus the ring thickness, and a height equal to the ring width. The writecylinder() function from the 'write/Write.scad' library is then subtracted from this outer cylinder to engrave the text. Finally, a second inner cylinder representing the finger hole is subtracted to hollow out the center of the ring.
